## Api Properties

### getProductCodeVersions

`apiProperties.getProductCodeVersions`

GET /d2l/api/(productCode)/versions/: Retrieve the collection of versions supported by a specific product component. Official reference: https://docs.valence.desire2learn.com/res/apiprop.html#get--d2l-api-(productCode)-versions-

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.d2lbrightspace.api.apiProperties.getProductCodeVersions({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `pathParams` | `object` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="pathParams full type">

```ts
{
  productCode: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ProductCode` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `LatestVersion` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `SupportedVersions` | `string[]` | Yes | — |



---

### getProductCodeVersionsVersion

`apiProperties.getProductCodeVersionsVersion`

GET /d2l/api/(productCode)/versions/(version): Determine if a specific product component supports a particular API version. Official reference: https://docs.valence.desire2learn.com/res/apiprop.html#get--d2l-api-(productCode)-versions-(version)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.d2lbrightspace.api.apiProperties.getProductCodeVersionsVersion({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `pathParams` | `object` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="pathParams full type">

```ts
{
  productCode: string,
  version: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Supported` | `boolean` | Yes | — |
| `LatestVersion` | `string` | Yes | — |

## Award Service

### deleteAwardsAwardId

`awardService.deleteAwardsAwardId`

DELETE /d2l/api/bas/(version)/awards/(awardId): Delete an award. Official reference: https://docs.valence.desire2learn.com/res/awards.html#delete--d2l-api-bas-(version)-awards-(awardId)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.d2lbrightspace.api.awardService.deleteAwardsAwardId({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `pathParams` | `object` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="pathParams full type">

```ts

  version: string,
  awardId: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output:** `JsonValue \| object \| undefined`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
JsonValue | {
  kind: binary,

  sizeBytes: number

  kind: upload_session,

  uploadedBytes: number
} | undefined
```
</Accordion>
